items.q: How uneven is enterprise AI impact?
items.a: Only about **37%** see positive EBIT contribution; ~**6%** are high performers.

items.q: What three pillars do leaders share?
items.a: **Design the right problem**, **build shared capabilities**, **compound the advantage**.

items.q: What becomes scarce when AI is cheap?
items.a: **Judgment**—picking problems and redesigning work, not more pilots.
High performers **redesign workflows** around judgment; laggards bolt AI onto old steps.

items.q: When someone learns a correction, what should happen?
items.a: Feed it back into **tools/context** so the **system** learns, not only the individual.
